verdicts.reason: A pulls the glow circle out of its starfield panel and sets the headline, subline and CTA on top of it, which leaves the panel as an empty dark box. The product can is shrunk to a tiny icon at the bottom. B keeps the copy column on the left and the circle inside its panel, but it also cuts the can down to an icon in the bottom-left corner, so the hero product is lost and the circle is an empty orange disc.

Both shrink the can to a stray icon and leave the circle empty. A's headline wraps with 'nights' alone on the last line, but there is a clear gutter between the copy and the panel. B keeps the original three-line wrap, but the end of 'slow' almost touches the panel's left edge, which crowds the copy.

These are nearly the same layout. In both, the circle sits outside an empty starfield panel, the headline runs right to the circle's edge and sits on it, and the can is a tiny icon stuck to the panel edge under the CTA. Neither has the original's product as its focal point.

A keeps a clean left copy column and the circle inside its panel, but the can is still a tiny icon in the bottom-left corner and the panel runs nearly to the right edge. B separates the circle from an empty panel, sets the copy on top of the circle and leaves the can as a tiny icon squeezed against the panel.
